tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Oat in light, near-black in dark. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: A secondary field: fact panels, code blocks, raised cards, table stripes. A tone step, never a shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and display type on paper (16:1 light, 15:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy in long passages, where full ink is too heavy (9.8:1 / 11.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, spec values, metadata, taglines. 4.9:1 minimum on paper-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline column and row rules. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, strong section rules. 3:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: fleece
tokens.usage: Brand primary — the slate-navy of a quilted vest. Primary buttons, links, avatar ground, focus ring in light.

tokens.name: fleece-ink
tokens.usage: Text on fleece (11:1 light, 7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Secondary hue — waxed-canvas olive. Section numerals, tags, data series 2. 6.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one loud note: a chartreuse highlight. Use as a GROUND only (badges, the active index, a single highlight block) with signal-ink text. Never as text or a border on light paper (1.2:1).

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Text on signal, both themes (14:1).

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only. Always paired with a word or icon, never colour alone (5.3:1 / 7.3:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, offset 2px. Fleece in light, signal in dark.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Fixed dark ground in both themes: footer, image placeholders behind full-bleed media.

tokens.name: night-ink
tokens.usage: Text on night, and on any image under the scrim (16:1 on night; ≥5:1 over any pixel under scrim).

tokens.name: night-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night: footer legal line, captions over media (7:1 on night).

tokens.name: night-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on night. Decorative only.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Flat overlay between a full-bleed image and its text. At 65% it guarantees night-ink text ≥4.5:1 over a pure-white pixel. Never lighter; never a gradient.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the person's name on Home, or the page name, flush left on the first column. Responsive: 56/56 below 640px, 80/80 at 640–1023px; this size from 1024px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section openers. Set tight; may be uppercase with 0.01em extra tracking. Responsive: 40/40 below 640px, 56/56 at 640–1023px; this size from 1024px.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Oversized section index numbers, in olive or ink. Tabular figures. Responsive: 64/64 below 640px, 88/80 at 640–1023px; this size from 1024px.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section, case-study and project headings. Responsive: 32/32 below 640px, 40/40 at 640–1023px; this size from 1024px.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “Boring technology is a choice you keep making.”
styles.usage: Pull quotes. Opening mark hangs outside the text edge. Steps down to 32/40 and 28/32 (see Grid · Responsive).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and sub-section titles. Responsive: 24/32 below 640px, 28/32 at 640–1023px; this size from 1024px.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I build the systems other teams quietly depend on.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a display heading; max 4 columns wide. Responsive: 18/24 below 640px, 20/32 at 640–1023px; this size from 1024px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Moved two billion jobs a day onto Postgres without downtime.
styles.usage: Running text. 3 baseline units of leading; measure 45–70 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Short notes set beside the main text.
styles.usage: Asides, card text, nav and footer links. Keeps the 24px body leading so it shares the baseline.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, footnotes, fact values, help text under form fields.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading or spec value (set text-transform: uppercase).

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Indices, counters, dates and handles in notes, version stamps.

styles.name: mono-data
styles.usage: Metrics, fact values with units, and code blocks (inline code at 0.875em).

spacing.note: Every vertical measure is a multiple of the 8px baseline (space-1). Horizontal measures come from the column grid.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: One baseline unit. Label-to-value gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Two units. Paragraph spacing at body size; button inline padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Three units = the column gutter = body leading.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its text.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page margin at desktop; gap between modules in a field.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: One grid-field row height. Between related sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between chapters; above a display-xl opener.

grid.note: The grid of Josef Müller-Brockmann, in tokens. Read with the Grid section of the brand book.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Columns from 1024px. 12 divides into 2, 3, 4 and 6 field layouts.

tokens.name: grid-columns-md
tokens.usage: Columns at 640–1023px.

tokens.name: grid-columns-sm
tokens.usage: Columns below 640px.

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Column gutter from 640px = one line of body type (3 baseline units).

tokens.name: grid-gutter-sm
tokens.usage: Column gutter below 640px (2 baseline units).

tokens.name: grid-margin
tokens.usage: Outer margin from 1024px.

tokens.name: grid-margin-md
tokens.usage: Outer margin at 640–1023px.

tokens.name: grid-margin-sm
tokens.usage: Outer margin at 480–639px.

tokens.name: grid-margin-xs
tokens.usage: Outer margin below 480px.

tokens.name: grid-baseline
tokens.usage: The baseline unit every line height and vertical space is a multiple of.

tokens.name: grid-field
tokens.usage: Field (module) row height: 8 baseline units. Images and blocks span whole fields plus gutters.

tokens.name: grid-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the content box including margins; grounds and full-bleed media run past it.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: margin 16 → 24.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: 4 → 8 columns, type steps up.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: 8 → 12 columns, full type scale, inline navigation.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Content stops growing; margins absorb the rest.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for everything: fields, images, cards, inputs, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Small chips and the focus outline corner only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots. Nothing else is round.
